name: 3D After Burner II
description:
3D After Burner II is a completely
re-mastered version of the arcade
classic. Pilot your F-14D fighter
through enemy territory blasting away
squadrons of enemy fighters. This
arcade masterpiece now features
stereoscopic 3D, a choice of real
arcade cabinets, new difficulty
settings as well as visual adjustments
options. Blast your way through 23
stages to unlock a special mode with
even more gameplay enhancements.
disclaimer: You may need an additional compatible SD card or SDHC card with available space to download this software. Visit support.nintendo.com for information about storage options. Sold separately.
